What is at stake

The backups are encrypted. Restored sign-ins or tokens may be out of date, so you may need to sign in once again; the saved data itself remains intact.

Without a backup, a disk failure could erase AI coding history and memory, Vault secrets and app keys that exist nowhere else. Host settings can be recreated by setup, but a copy preserves exactly how they were set.
